## game-ops-monitor 1.0.3 Changelog

- Added explicit objHash validation (hex check) to all sample code blocks, improving shell security when using Scouter Collector responses.
- Updated documentation with step-by-step shell validation instructions and security notes to prevent shell injection attacks.
- No changes to skill logic; documentation and workflow examples enhanced for safer operational usage.

- Added explicit metadata fields for required binaries (`curl`, `jq`) and required environment variables (`SCOUTER_COLLECTOR_URL`, `SCOUTER_OBJ_TYPE`) under the `metadata.openclaw` section.  
- No changes to functionality or user-facing documentation; update is metadata-only to clarify prerequisites for deployment and operation.

game-ops-monitor 1.0.1 is a minor update with documentation and metadata improvements.

- Added _meta.json for improved metadata handling.
- Updated references/PORT_NOTES.md and alert-workflow.md for clearer documentation and workflow guidance.
- No changes to core functionality or main API.
Initial release: real-time game server monitoring via Scouter. Supports TPS, online users, JVM heap queries, alert detection, and performance reports. Works with Hermes Agent and OpenClaw.
